english.title: Person in charge of traffic service equipment fail to preserve article 206(5) / 206(8) record for required period
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person in charge of air traffic service equipment, failed to preserve a record, namely **(..SPECIFY RECORD..), made in compliance with article 206(5) or (8) of the Air Navigation Order 2016 for

(A)_[30 days]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY PERIOD..), being the period directed by the CAA,]_

from the date on which the terms or content of the message or signal were recorded
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 206(10) and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a person in charge of air traffic service equipment,
failed to preserve a record made in compliance with article 206(5) or (8) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
for 30 days or for such longer period as the CAA may direct
from the date on which the terms or content of the message or signal were recorded.
